data.title: 猫猫 · 雨廊下的药箱
data.description: 骤雨回廊，她抱着药箱小跑，为避雨躲在廊下检查里面的药瓶是否安好；确认无恙后松了口气，抱着药箱的样子像抱着什么宝物。
data.action: 骤雨回廊，她抱着药箱小跑，为避雨躲在廊下检查里面的药瓶是否安好
data.promptProse: Maomao stops beneath the corridor after running through the sudden rain, opening her medical case just enough to check each sealed bottle. Her dark-green cape is wet over a closed-collar robe and practical shoes. She exhales in relief, refastening the latch with the case held close. The medium view includes receding corridor posts and rain beyond; overcast daylight reveals droplets and bottle shoulders, with protected interior shadows beneath the case lid.
